game.title: Shadow of the Tomb Raider: Definitive Edition

roadmap.title: Story playthrough with combat achievements
roadmap.description: Play the story on an easy difficulty and finish the combat achievements during it: no enemies spawn after the final mission. The early Cozumel fights suit Playing with Fire and Gunslinger; the mud wall takedown is in Kuwaq Yaku.

roadmap.title: Side missions, skills, crafting and shopping
roadmap.description: Do side missions in the three towns before the final mission, buy skills, craft ammo, buy gear and restore outfits.

roadmap.title: Collectibles cleanup in free roam
roadmap.description: After the story, use Continue and free roam to finish tombs, crypts, chests, artifacts, challenges and monoliths, then Completionist.

roadmap.title: DLC missions, tombs and medals
roadmap.description: Seven DLC missions, each with a challenge tomb, an outfit achievement and Time and Score Attack medals.

roadmap.title: Deadly Obsession New Game+
roadmap.description: Replay in New Game+ on Deadly Obsession with the maxed character; it also unlocks the lower difficulty achievements.

achievements.description: Decipher a Monolith
achievements.summary: Decipher one monolith.

guide.context: Archivist Maps show relics, documents, murals and monoliths on the map.

steps.text: Collect documents, relics and murals until a language is fully learned.
Interact with a monolith of that language, then dig up the secret treasure in the search area it marks on the map.

achievements.description: Complete all Artifact Collections
achievements.summary: Complete all artifact collections.

guide.context: Artifacts also come from side missions. Artifacts in the Croft Manor dream are story unlocks and not needed.

steps.text: Collect every relic and open every treasure chest, then check each artifact collection on the map menu.
Dig up the Antique Knife behind the murder house in @loc{Paititi} (side mission Investigate Sumaq's Murder); it can still be dug up after the mission.
Repeat until every collection shows 100%.

achievements.description: Complete 3 main game Challenge Tombs
achievements.summary: Complete 3 main game challenge tombs.

guide.context: See the Tomb Raider guide for all 9 tombs.

steps.text: Finish any 3 of the 9 main game challenge tombs. Each tomb ends at a stele and grants a skill.

achievements.description: Complete all main game Challenge Tombs
achievements.summary: Complete all 9 main game challenge tombs.

guide.context: None of the tombs can be missed. Each needs no special gear and grants a skill. Tombs also hold gold ore.

collectibles.name: Underworld Gate
collectibles.location: Entrance in front of the Jungle Ruins camp.
collectibles.method: Turn the crane platform with its lever, link it by rope arrow to the far side, then ride the hanging box using the big lever.

collectibles.name: Judge's Gaze
collectibles.location: North-east, near the Plane Wreckage camp.
collectibles.method: Tether both counterweight statues to the bridge with rope arrows, using the two carts to lock each weight.

collectibles.name: Howling Caves
collectibles.location: Middle of the region, near the Kuwaq Yaku Ruins camp, behind a cave with yellow skulls.
collectibles.method: Pull the levers to open the shutters and put out the fire, using a rope arrow on the spiked pendulum.

collectibles.name: Path of Battle
collectibles.location: North-west of Paititi: pass the cave, then dive into the pool by the waterfall.
collectibles.method: Pull the levers and run through the spinning blade platforms before the timer ends.

collectibles.name: Temple of the Sun
collectibles.location: South Paititi: dive into the well in the house, near the Village Caves camp, and clear the wooden blockade.
collectibles.method: Aim the mirrors at the connecting sticks in turn to climb to the last mirror.

collectibles.name: Ancient Aqueduct
collectibles.location: East Paititi: drop down the wall by the river in front of the Temple of Kukulkan camp.
collectibles.method: Kick the raft to the rope-marked floodgate, tether it and fill the room with the top lever; later tether the raft and water wheel to the overhead anchors to reach the raised platform.

collectibles.name: San Cordoba
collectibles.location: North of the Cenote, near the Cenote Temple Ruins camp; jump to the dark cave entrance north-east of the camp.
collectibles.method: Swim the cove past the eels, climb to the stranded ship, and drop its cannon through the breakable floor using the lever and the winches.

collectibles.name: Tree of Life
collectibles.location: South-east, near the Ruined Tower camp in the Empress Jaguar jungle.
collectibles.method: Use fire arrows on the green gas or the winch under each stone head to clear paths; clear the enemy waves and climb to the stele at the top.

collectibles.name: Thirsty Gods
collectibles.location: South-east: swim east from the Ruined Tower camp to the entrance with yellow skulls.
collectibles.method: Drain the water room, cut the underwater rafts loose, hook the water wheel to the anchor by rope arrow and open the floodgate with the spigot before the rope snaps.

achievements.description: Perform the Serpent's Fury 3 times
achievements.summary: Perform the Serpent's Fury takedown 3 times.

guide.context: Others noticing you during the move is fine. Missable: no enemies spawn after the story ends. If you miss it, a New Game+ run gets it back.

steps.text: Buy @mechanic{Serpent's Strike} (1 point), then @mechanic{Serpent's Fury} (2 points) at a base camp.
Sneak up on two enemies standing next to each other, take down the first, and press the button repeatedly so Lara jumps to the second.
Do this on 3 pairs of enemies.

achievements.description: Stealth Takedown 25 enemies
achievements.summary: Stealth takedown 25 enemies.

guide.context: Missable: no enemies spawn after the story ends. If you miss it, a New Game+ run gets it back.

steps.text: Sneak up behind unaware enemies and press the takedown button. Reload the checkpoint in a fight to repeat takedowns.

achievements.description: Restore and equip a matching vestige outfit
achievements.summary: Restore a vestige outfit set and wear both of its pieces.

guide.context: A matching set has an upper and lower piece with the same word in their names.

steps.text: Open crypts to get vestige pieces; for example the two Peruvian Jungle crypts give the Evening Star set.
At a @loc{base camp} open Inventory and restore both the upper and lower piece of one set, then equip both.

achievements.description: Fully upgrade a weapon
achievements.summary: Fully upgrade one weapon.

steps.text: Buy @mechanic{Raposa's Wit} so weapons can be fully upgraded.
At a @loc{base camp}, buy every upgrade for one weapon. The bow has only 8 upgrades.

achievements.description: Complete 5 Challenges
achievements.summary: Complete 5 challenges.

guide.context: 100% completion needs all 15 listed here. Challenge items are not marked by maps or backpacks, so buy Owl's Wisdom (Seeker) to show them in Survival Instinct. The Croft Manor Bullseye challenge is not needed.

collectibles.name: Whistle in the Dark
collectibles.location: Death whistles are spread across the area; Survival Instinct with Owl's Wisdom shows them.

collectibles.name: Ruffled Feathers
collectibles.location: Oropendola nests are spread across the area; Survival Instinct with Owl's Wisdom shows them.

collectibles.name: Flower Picker
collectibles.location: Canopy plants are spread across the area; Survival Instinct with Owl's Wisdom shows them.

collectibles.name: Nam Deus
collectibles.location: Jungle totems are spread across the area; Survival Instinct with Owl's Wisdom shows them.

collectibles.name: Crude Awakenings
collectibles.location: Oil barrels are spread across the area; Survival Instinct with Owl's Wisdom shows them.

collectibles.name: Bottom Feeder
collectibles.location: Aquatic plants are spread across the area; Survival Instinct with Owl's Wisdom shows them.

collectibles.name: Keep Calm and Carrion
collectibles.location: Condor nests are spread across the area; Survival Instinct with Owl's Wisdom shows them.

collectibles.name: High Diving
collectibles.location: High dives are spread across the area; Survival Instinct with Owl's Wisdom shows them.

collectibles.name: Dunkin' Bones
collectibles.location: Skeleton poles are spread across the area; Survival Instinct with Owl's Wisdom shows them.

collectibles.name: Dropping Decimals
collectibles.location: Hanging quipus are spread across the area; Survival Instinct with Owl's Wisdom shows them.

collectibles.name: Changing the Weather
collectibles.location: Frog totems are spread across the area; Survival Instinct with Owl's Wisdom shows them.

collectibles.name: Speak of the Dead
collectibles.location: Crypts are spread across the area; Survival Instinct with Owl's Wisdom shows them.

collectibles.name: Sunken Treasure
collectibles.location: Underwater chests are spread across the area; Survival Instinct with Owl's Wisdom shows them.

collectibles.name: Respected
collectibles.location: Effigies are spread across the area; Survival Instinct with Owl's Wisdom shows them.

collectibles.name: Raise the Flags
collectibles.location: Flag pulleys are spread across the area; Survival Instinct with Owl's Wisdom shows them.
collectibles.method: Cut the release pulleys to lift 5 flags.

achievements.description: Restore 5 vestige outfit pieces
achievements.summary: Restore 5 vestige outfit pieces.

guide.context: The skill Anole's Needle lowers restore costs.

steps.text: Collect vestige pieces from crypts, side mission rewards and vendors.
At a @loc{base camp} open Inventory and restore 5 pieces for resources.

achievements.description: Complete a Side Mission
achievements.summary: Complete a side mission.

steps.text: Take the first side mission, @item{Deal with the Pillagers}, from the NPC in @loc{Kuwaq Yaku}, or any other available side mission, and finish it.

achievements.description: Complete 8 Side Missions
achievements.summary: Complete 8 side missions.

guide.context: The game has 13 side missions and 100% completion needs all of them: Deal with the Pillagers, Decipher the Murals, Explore the Local Mysteries, Find Takiy's Dice, Free the Rebels, Investigate Sumaq's Murder, Rescue Hakan, Retrieve the Champion's Bow, Retrieve the King's Horn, Retrieve the Savior's Amulet, Save Colqui, Seek Out the Outcasts and Stop the Ritual. Do them before the final mission to be safe.

steps.text: Finish side missions in @loc{Kuwaq Yaku}, @loc{Paititi} and the @loc{Mission of San Juan}. Quest givers show on the map and glow green in Survival Instinct.

achievements.description: Perform 5 Eagle's Talon Takedowns
achievements.summary: Perform 5 Eagle's Talon takedowns.

guide.context: Each branch holds only one body. Reload the checkpoint in a fight to repeat. Missable: no enemies spawn after the story ends. If you miss it, a New Game+ run gets it back.

steps.text: After the skill unlocks automatically in mission Path of the Dead (@loc{Kuwaq Yaku}), climb onto a tree branch above an unaware enemy.
Hold the aim button and shoot a rope arrow at the enemy to pull the enemy up. Repeat on 5 enemies.

achievements.description: Purchase a Skill
achievements.summary: Buy a skill.

steps.text: At any @loc{base camp}, buy any skill with your skill points.

achievements.description: Earn all skills in one category
achievements.summary: Buy every skill in one skill category.

guide.context: Tip: save skill points, overwrite your manual save slots, buy everything, then reload an older slot to get the points back for other uses.

steps.text: Finish the story and every challenge tomb first, because some skills unlock only through them.
At a @loc{base camp}, buy all skills in one tree: Seeker (blue), Scavenger (green) or Warrior (red).

achievements.description: Find and open all the main game Conquistador treasure chests
achievements.summary: Find and open all main game Conquistador treasure chests.

guide.context: Each chest adds an artifact to your collections.

steps.text: Buy a @item{Lockpick} from a merchant in @loc{Paititi}; the merchant stands in a fixed spot during side mission Find Takiy's Dice, so buy it before moving on.
Use an @item{Explorer Backpack} to mark chests on the map, then pick each one open. Chests are in Cozumel, the Peruvian Jungle, Kuwaq Yaku, Paititi and the Mission of San Juan.

achievements.description: Buy an item from a merchant
achievements.summary: Buy an item from a merchant.

steps.text: Buy anything from a merchant in @loc{Kuwaq Yaku}, @loc{Paititi} or the @loc{Mission of San Juan}.

achievements.description: Kill 5 enemies while they are searching for Lara
achievements.summary: Kill 5 enemies who are hunting for Lara after losing sight of her.

guide.context: Keep one enemy alive before reloading, or the game autosaves. Missable: no enemies spawn after the story ends. If you miss it, a New Game+ run gets it back.

steps.text: In a fight, let enemies see Lara, then hide in foliage or behind a wall until they stop shooting and start searching.
Take down the enemies who come close. Reload the checkpoint and repeat until 5 are dead.

achievements.description: Kill 3 enemies while they are distracted
achievements.summary: Kill 3 enemies that are busy investigating a distraction.

guide.context: An enemy is distracted while checking a noise or body, or fighting an animal. Missable: no enemies spawn after the story ends. If you miss it, a New Game+ run gets it back.

steps.text: Distract enemies with a thrown @item{bottle} or an arrow shot at a surface, then kill a distracted enemy.
Repeat until 3 distracted enemies are dead; they do not need to die together.

achievements.description: Kill 5 enemies with friendly fire
achievements.summary: Kill 5 enemies with friendly fire.

guide.context: The Jaguar's Fear skill unlocks Fear Arrows at that point in the story. Missable: no enemies spawn after the story ends. If you miss it, a New Game+ run gets it back.

steps.text: After you leave Paititi to look for Jonah, craft a @item{Fear Arrow} using Cloth, Dart Poison and a Silent Arrow.
Shoot enemies in groups with it so the hit enemy attacks the others; repeat until 5 are killed this way.

achievements.description: Burn 2 enemies simultaneously
achievements.summary: Burn 2 enemies at the same time.

guide.context: Missable: no enemies spawn after the story ends. If you miss it, a New Game+ run gets it back.

steps.text: In the second enemy encounter in @loc{Cozumel} (mission Hunter's Moon, Get through the Dig Site), pick up a bottle from the forklift and hold the craft button to make a @item{Molotov cocktail}.
Throw it at two enemies standing close together.

achievements.description: Perform 3 headshots in 3 seconds with the pistol
achievements.summary: Perform 3 pistol headshots within 3 seconds.

guide.context: Missable: no enemies spawn after the story ends. If you miss it, a New Game+ run gets it back.

steps.text: Reach the second enemy encounter in @loc{Cozumel} (mission Hunter's Moon, objective Get through the Dig Site) with three enemies around a forklift.
Equip the pistol, stand behind the lone enemy near the bushes and headshot all three from right to left within 3 seconds.
The kills autosave. Keep a separate save slot made before the section, and save again to another slot right after reloading.
If it fails, move on to the nearby enemy base and restart the checkpoint there to try again.

achievements.description: Lose the enemy 10 times
achievements.summary: Make enemies lose track of Lara 10 times.

guide.context: Leaving one enemy alive makes this faster and avoids an autosave. Missable: no enemies spawn after the story ends. If you miss it, a New Game+ run gets it back.

steps.text: In a fight, get spotted, break line of sight and hide behind a wall until enemies start searching (about 15 seconds).
Reload the checkpoint and repeat until it has happened 10 times.

achievements.description: Defeat the Nahual
achievements.summary: Defeat the Nahual.

guide.context: The mission appears right as the story nears its end, after San Juan, and remains doable in free roam. Clear the other Paititi side missions first.

steps.text: Finish the @loc{Paititi} side mission @item{Retrieve the Champion's Bow} and defeat the @enemy{Nahual}.

achievements.description: Hunt and kill 10 enemies while Perception is active
achievements.summary: Kill 10 enemies with takedowns while Perception is active.

guide.context: Weapon kills do not count and the effect lasts only seconds. The counter can take many more takedowns than 10 to unlock; reload the checkpoint to keep farming. Missable: no enemies spawn after the story ends. If you miss it, a New Game+ run gets it back.

steps.text: Buy @mechanic{Eye of the Eagle} (Seeker tree) and gather plants to craft a @item{Perception} mixture.
Use the mixture, then take down enemies with melee or stealth takedowns before it fades; repeat until 10 count.

achievements.description: Kill 10 enemies while Focus is active
achievements.summary: Kill 10 enemies with takedowns while Focus is active.

guide.context: Weapon kills do not count and the effect lasts only seconds. The counter can take many more takedowns than 10 to unlock; reload the checkpoint to keep farming. Missable: no enemies spawn after the story ends. If you miss it, a New Game+ run gets it back.

steps.text: Buy @mechanic{Scales of the Serpent} (Scavenger tree) and craft a @item{Focus} mixture from plants.
Use the mixture, then take down enemies with melee or stealth takedowns before it fades; repeat until 10 count.

achievements.description: Takedown 10 enemies while Endurance is active
achievements.summary: Perform 10 takedowns while Endurance is active.

guide.context: Weapon kills do not count and the effect lasts only seconds. The counter can take many more takedowns than 10 to unlock; reload the checkpoint to keep farming. Missable: no enemies spawn after the story ends. If you miss it, a New Game+ run gets it back.

steps.text: Buy @mechanic{Heart of the Jaguar} (Warrior tree) and craft an @item{Endurance} mixture from plants.
Use the mixture, then take down enemies with stealth takedowns before it fades; repeat until 10 count.

achievements.description: Pet 5 llamas
achievements.summary: Pet 5 different llamas.

steps.text: Press interact beside 5 different llamas. Paititi has one near the Unuratu's Home camp, one on the hillside close by, two in the market square and one in the houses up the hill to the south-west. The @loc{Mission of San Juan} stables hold two more.

achievements.description: Collect 5 underwater Artifacts
achievements.summary: Collect 5 underwater relics.

steps.text: Dive for relics in water areas; 5 of the relics you collect must be underwater. This comes naturally during collecting.

achievements.description: Complete a climb after finding the Overhang Climbing Gear
achievements.summary: Finish a climb using the Overhang Climbing Gear after you find it.

guide.context: Unmissable story unlock.

steps.text: Follow the story to the end of the @loc{Cenote} region (mission Rebellion Lives), find the @item{Overhang Climbing Gear} and use it for a climb.

achievements.description: Fully upgrade the knife
achievements.summary: Fully upgrade the knife.

guide.context: Upper Paititi opens only when Lara wears the Serpent Guard outfit (green), which she gets later in the story.

steps.text: Buy the @item{Reinforced Knife} upgrade from a merchant at the Paititi market for 2900 gold.
Finish the side mission @item{Rescue Hakan} in upper Paititi; the girl there hands over the second upgrade.

achievements.description: Collect 20 critters
achievements.summary: Collect 20 critters.

guide.context: Survival Instinct or Perception plants highlight critters.

steps.text: Buy @mechanic{Owl's Meal} (Seeker tree).
Step on beetles crawling across the jungle floor, and on spiders in tombs and crypts, until the count reaches 20.

achievements.description: Hunt and loot 5 rare animals
achievements.summary: Hunt and loot 5 rare animals.

steps.text: Buy @mechanic{Eagle's Grasp} (Seeker tree) to raise their spawn chance.

Kill and loot rare animals (red in Survival Instinct) such as jaguars and black wolves. Good spots: camp @loc{Jaguar Den} (Peruvian Jungle), camp @loc{Mission Gate} cave south-west of the entrance (Mission of San Juan), and the cave north-west of camp @loc{Abandoned Village} (Paititi, reached by swimming).
Fast travel between camps to respawn animals.

achievements.description: Gather 40 gold ore
achievements.summary: Gather 40 gold ore.

steps.text: Mine gold ore in challenge tombs (10 to 12 per tomb), crypts and underwater areas until you have 40.

achievements.description: Perform 20 headshots with the bow
achievements.summary: Get 20 bow kills with headshots.

guide.context: Keep one enemy alive before reloading, or the game autosaves. Missable: no enemies spawn after the story ends. If you miss it, a New Game+ run gets it back.

steps.text: Use the bow to headshot enemies in fights, reloading the checkpoint to repeat until you reach 20.

achievements.description: Perform a Stealth Takedown from a mud-covered wall
achievements.summary: Perform a stealth takedown while leaning on a mud-covered wall.

guide.context: Works only while Lara is covered in mud. Missable: no enemies spawn after the story ends. If you miss it, a New Game+ run gets it back.

steps.text: In mission Path of the Living (@loc{Kuwaq Yaku}), at the @loc{Porvenir Camp}, step on the mud patch with the tutorial prompt to cover Lara in mud.
Move to the next waypoint where enemies and a mud wall are, lean against the wall and take down an enemy walking past.

achievements.description: Get rid of the pillagers outside of Kuwaq Yaku
achievements.summary: Get rid of the pillagers outside Kuwaq Yaku.

steps.text: Take the side mission @item{Deal with the Pillagers} from an NPC in @loc{Kuwaq Yaku} and finish it.

achievements.description: Rescue Hakan from the cultist
achievements.summary: Rescue Hakan from the cultist.

guide.context: This is offered right before you save Unuratu. It also gives the second knife upgrade.

steps.text: During the story in upper @loc{Paititi}, accept the side mission @item{Rescue Hakan} from Etzli and finish it.

achievements.description: Retrieve Manko's Necklace
achievements.summary: Retrieve Manko's Necklace.

steps.text: Finish the @loc{Paititi} side missions @item{Retrieve the King's Horn} and @item{Retrieve the Savior's Amulet}; the necklace achievement then unlocks.

achievements.description: Craft special ammunition 50 times
achievements.summary: Craft special ammunition 50 times.

guide.context: If your inventory is full, shoot spare special ammo at the scenery to free space.

steps.text: Hold the craft button on a weapon with special ammo, such as fire arrows for the bow, and repeat 50 times.

achievements.description: Learn of 5 interesting locations from civilians
achievements.summary: Hear about 5 points of interest from townspeople.

guide.context: Survival Instinct shows talkers in yellow. Paititi has the most people.

steps.text: Talk to townspeople (chat icon above their heads) in @loc{Kuwaq Yaku}, @loc{Paititi} and the @loc{Mission of San Juan} until they have told you of 5 animals, crypts or tombs.

achievements.description: Shoot a turkey with a Flare Round
achievements.summary: Hit a turkey with a flare round from the pistol.

guide.context: Make a spare save first so you can refund the skill points.

steps.text: Buy @mechanic{Serpent's Glint} (green tree) to unlock flare rounds for the pistol.
Fast travel to the @loc{Ruined Tower} camp in the @loc{Mission of San Juan}, find one of the turkeys in the bushes and shoot it with a flare round.

achievements.description: Get 3 pieces of equipment
achievements.summary: Get 3 pieces of equipment.

steps.text: At the @loc{Kuwaq Yaku} merchant, buy Pistol Sight for 1800 gold, Pistol Suppressor for 1400 and Pistol Ammo Pouch for 1500.

achievements.description: Decipher the Path of the Stars
achievements.summary: Decipher the Path of the Stars in the first story chapters on Cozumel.

guide.context: Unmissable story unlock.

steps.text: Follow the story in @loc{Cozumel} until Lara deciphers the Path of the Stars.

achievements.description: Remove the dagger from the Temple of the Moon
achievements.summary: Pull the dagger out at the Temple of the Moon.

guide.context: Unmissable story unlock.

steps.text: Follow the story in @loc{Cozumel} to the @loc{Temple of the Moon} and take out the dagger.

achievements.description: Survive the flood
achievements.summary: Survive the flood in the Cozumel story chapters.

guide.context: Unmissable story unlock.

steps.text: Follow the story in @loc{Cozumel} until Lara survives the flood.

achievements.description: Defeat the Empress Jaguar
achievements.summary: Defeat the Empress Jaguar in the Peruvian Jungle.

guide.context: Unmissable story unlock.

steps.text: Follow the story in the @loc{Peruvian Jungle} to the @enemy{Empress Jaguar} fight and win it.

achievements.description: Enter the Temple of Life's inner chamber
achievements.summary: Reach the inner chamber of the Temple of Life in Kuwaq Yaku.

guide.context: Unmissable story unlock.

steps.text: Follow the story in @loc{Kuwaq Yaku} until Lara enters the inner chamber of the @loc{Temple of Life}.

achievements.description: Find Paititi
achievements.summary: Find Paititi.

guide.context: Unmissable story unlock.

steps.text: Follow the story until Lara reaches the hidden city of @loc{Paititi}.

achievements.description: Get out of the Cenotes alive
achievements.summary: Get out of the Cenotes alive.

guide.context: Unmissable story unlock.

steps.text: Follow the story through the @loc{Cenote} region until Lara escapes.

achievements.description: Free Unuratu from prison
achievements.summary: Free Unuratu from prison.

guide.context: Unmissable story unlock.

steps.text: Follow the story in @loc{Paititi} until Unuratu is freed.

achievements.description: Find the Mission of San Juan
achievements.summary: Find the Mission of San Juan.

guide.context: Unmissable story unlock.

steps.text: Follow the story until Lara reaches the @loc{Mission of San Juan}.

achievements.description: Find the Silver Box of Ix Chel
achievements.summary: Locate Ix Chel's Silver Box.

guide.context: Unmissable story unlock.

steps.text: Follow the story in the @loc{Mission of San Juan} until Lara reaches the @item{Silver Box of Ix Chel}.

achievements.description: Return to Paititi
achievements.summary: Return to Paititi.

guide.context: Unmissable story unlock.

steps.text: Follow the story after the Silver Box until Lara is back in @loc{Paititi}.

achievements.description: Make an unlikely ally
achievements.summary: Ally with an unlikely partner in the City of the Serpent story chapters.

guide.context: Unmissable story unlock.

steps.text: Follow the story in the @loc{City of the Serpent} until the unlikely alliance is made.

achievements.description: Finish the main storyline
achievements.summary: Finish the main story on any difficulty.

guide.context: Combat achievements cannot be earned after the story ends.

steps.text: Play the main story to the end.
The game warns before the point of no return. Side missions and collectibles stay available in free roam afterwards, but no enemies spawn.

achievements.description: Complete Shadow of the Tomb Raider on Smart and Resourceful difficulty
achievements.summary: Finish the main story on Smart and Resourceful difficulty.

guide.context: A higher difficulty also unlocks every lower one, so finishing Deadly Obsession covers all three.

steps.text: Start or continue a game on Smart and Resourceful and finish the story.

achievements.description: Complete Shadow of the Tomb Raider on Rite of Passage difficulty
achievements.summary: Finish the main story on Rite of Passage difficulty.

guide.context: A higher difficulty also unlocks every lower one, so finishing Deadly Obsession covers all three.

steps.text: Start or continue a game on Rite of Passage and finish the story.

achievements.description: Complete Shadow of the Tomb Raider on One with the Jungle difficulty
achievements.summary: Finish the main story on One with the Jungle difficulty.

guide.context: A higher difficulty also unlocks every lower one, so finishing Deadly Obsession covers all three.

steps.text: Start or continue a game on One with the Jungle and finish the story.

achievements.description: Complete an Artifact Collection
achievements.summary: Complete one artifact collection.

guide.context: If a collection stays short, check side mission artifacts: the Pantheon of the Gods collection needs the Antique Knife buried behind the murder house in Paititi (side mission Investigate Sumaq's Murder).

steps.text: Collect relics and open treasure chests, then check the artifact collections on the map menu until one is full.

achievements.description: Uncover 3 main game Crypts' secrets
achievements.summary: Uncover 3 main game crypts' secrets.

guide.context: Crypts: Peruvian Jungle 2, Kuwaq Yaku 2, Paititi 5, Mission of San Juan 1. Their rewards include vestige outfit pieces.

steps.text: Finish 3 of the 10 crypts and open the sarcophagus at the end of each.

achievements.description: Complete Shadow of the Tomb Raider on Deadly Obsession difficulty
achievements.summary: Finish the main story on Deadly Obsession difficulty.

guide.context: This difficulty gives no climbing markers or puzzle hints and no Survival Instinct. It also unlocks the lower difficulty achievements.

steps.text: Finish an easy run with all skills first, then start @mechanic{New Game+} on Deadly Obsession to keep your skills, money and items.
Light base camps to save: the game saves only at camps, which cost resources, and there are no checkpoints.
Prepare well before the final boss, the only hard fight.

achievements.description: Reach 100% completion
achievements.summary: Reach 100% completion.

guide.context: All 378 collectibles plus challenge items count. Archivist Maps and Explorer Backpacks show them on the map. DLC items and Croft Manor items do not count. If you are stuck at 99%, check the artifact collections.

steps.text: Finish the story, then choose Continue from the main menu to free roam.
Collect every item, finish all challenges, tombs, crypts, artifact collections and side missions, then check the completion tracker on the map.

achievements.description: Obtain a Bronze, Silver, or Gold medal in Time Attack for the Forge of Destiny Challenge Tomb
achievements.summary: Get a medal of any rank from the Time Attack run of the Forge of Destiny tomb.

steps.text: Finish the Forge of Destiny tomb once, then run it in Time Attack to a medal.

achievements.description: Obtain the Grenadier Skill, equip the Umbrage 3-80 Shade weapon, and Brocken Shadow outfit
achievements.summary: Have the Grenadier skill and the Umbrage 3-80 Shade weapon plus the Brocken Shadow outfit equipped at once.

steps.text: Finish Echoes of the Past for the rifle and outfit, and buy the @mechanic{Grenadier} skill.
At a @loc{base camp}, equip the rifle and outfit, then leave the camp.

achievements.description: Complete the Forge of Destiny Challenge Tomb
achievements.summary: Finish the Forge of Destiny tomb.

guide.context: Opens after the main mission The Trial of the Eagle.

steps.text: Start the side mission Echoes of the Past in @loc{Kuwaq Yaku} and finish the tomb inside it.

achievements.description: Obtain a Bronze, Silver, or Gold medal in Score Attack for the Forge of Destiny Challenge Tomb
achievements.summary: Get a medal of any rank from the Score Attack run of the Forge of Destiny tomb.

steps.text: Finish the Forge of Destiny tomb once, then run it in Score Attack to a medal.
Shoot hanging lanterns while your multiplier is high for extra score.
